group.title: Notes
group.description: Personal notes in the team wiki. Use it to find or read meeting notes and how-to pages, not for issues (use tracker).

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search notes
tools.description: Search wiki notes by title and body text. Returns up to 20 matches with note ID, title, and the first 200 characters. Use get_note to read a full note.

tools.name: get_note
tools.title: Get note
tools.description: Get the full Markdown body of one wiki note by ID. IDs come from search_notes. Notes longer than 20,000 characters are truncated with a marker.
